## DPStyleARWebLive.changeTo() method

Change the active StyleAR product. This method switches the internal StyleAR pipeline to the specified product type after initialization has completed.

**Signature:**

```typescript
changeTo(styleARProduct: DPStyleARProduct): Promise<void>;
```
